purpose: Map measured closed-loop device actuation evidence into runtime-state-v1 without duplicating Formula mathematics.

observationWindow.rule: 16 comparable observations under one device class, capability, provider, authority policy and calibrated timeout regime.

calibration.timingLaw: No universal timeout is canonical until measured for the actual device/provider path.

claimBoundary: Provider ACK, API success, simulation, wrapper presence and test fixtures do not prove physical actuation. Fresh authoritative read-back is required for physical promotion.
